title: Top floor one bedroom plus office
body:
Top floor one bedroom plus office apartment in a Victorian building located near Valencia and 19th. In-unit laundry. Unit is on the third floor of a three floor building. The first bedroom fits king bed +a separate room can be used as office.

**Photos of a similar apartment in the same building to show how the room can look like with furniture; furniture do not come with the apartment.
****************************************************

• Stainless steel appliances and quartz counter top
• Dishwasher, gas stove
• In unit washer and dryer
• Engineered wood floor throughout entire unit
• Bay windows facing a quiet side street off Valencia
• Bathroom has a shower over tub
• Shared bike rack in backyard

****************************************************
Neighborhood:
• Location! 5 minute walk to Dolores Park, BART station at 16th and Mission, and tech company buses. Easy access to 280 and 101.
• Situated in a quiet street off the Valencia Mission Dolores corridor
• Around the corner to restaurants, coffee houses & dessert places - walk score of 99

******************************************************************************
Other details:
• No parking available in building
• Non-smoking unit
• Renter’s insurance required
• Tenant pays for all utilities; rent does not include utilities
• Available now
• 12 month lease
• Security deposit is 1 month's rent
• 1 small dog or 1 cat will be considered (dog must be under 30 pounds and no aggressive breeds) with additional pet deposit and pet rent of $50 per pet per month
• For number of occupants more than 2, additional $400 rent per additional occupant to cover wear and tear.
• Rent controlled unit


************************************************************************************
How to apply:
1. One page application, available via email
2. $30 application fee per occupant

Showing detail:
Please email or text for showing appointment and indicate number of occupants. Virtual video available before scheduling in-person tour.

body:

• Location! 5 minute walk to Dolores Park, BART station at 16th and Mission, and tech company buses. Easy access to 280 and 101.
• Situated in a quiet street off the Valencia Mission Dolores corridor
• Around the corner to restaurants, coffee houses & dessert places - walk score of 99

• No parking available in building
• Non-smoking unit
• Renter’s insurance required
• Tenant pays for all utilities; rent does not include utilities
• Available now
• 12 month lease

• 1 small dog or 1 cat will be considered (dog must be under 30 pounds and no aggressive breeds) with additional pet deposit and pet rent of $50 per pet per month
• For number of occupants more than 2, additional $400 rent per additional occupant to cover wear and tear.
• Rent controlled unit


************************************************************************************
